zh: 每个屋顶格子恰好属于一个四连通分量（一栋房屋），房屋面积就是分量的格子数，对角线不算相连。
对每个还没访问过的 1 做一次 BFS 或 DFS，就能完整走遍它所在的房屋并数出格子数。
用访问标记数组扫描整个网格；遇到未访问的 1 就从它出发只沿上下左右扩展到值为 1 的未访问格子，统计个数并更新最大值。没有 1 时答案是 0。网格最多 2×10⁵ 格，用队列或显式栈避免递归过深。
en: Every roof cell belongs to exactly one 4-connected component (one house), and a house's area is the number of its cells; diagonal cells are not connected.
Running one BFS or DFS from each unvisited 1 visits its whole house and counts its cells.

Scan the grid with a visited array; at each unvisited 1, expand only up, down, left and right to unvisited cells with value 1, count them and update the maximum. With no 1 the answer is 0. The grid has up to 2×10^5 cells, so use a queue or an explicit stack instead of deep recursion.

explanationEn:
## Idea

Run a 4-directional BFS/DFS from every 1 not yet visited, count the size of that connected component and update the maximum.

## Proof of correctness

Every 1 belongs to exactly one 4-connected component, and the BFS visits exactly that component; the maximum of all component sizes is what the problem asks for.

## Complexity

O(nm) time, O(nm) space.

## Source and additions

https://oamaster.com/docs/companies/hsbc#3-find-largest-house-area; the connectivity rule of the original problem is clear; this site adds the grid size and the result for a grid without houses.
